facts.fact: The World Bank project information document of 10 May 2021 allots US$10.5 million of a US$68.5 million IBRD financing, the whole project cost, to sub-component 2.2, digitalisation of the civil registration system including birth registration; no domestic contribution is shown.

The World Bank project information document of 10 May 2021 states the planned digitalised civil registration system, the population registry and the national ID system will be governed by the same state entity, the CNEC, with the project implemented by a unit housed in the Ministry of Communication and Digital Economy and technical coordination by ANINF.

systems.owner: CNEC (planned governing entity); project unit in the Ministry of Communication and Digital Economy; ANINF technical coordination
systems.tiers: planned in May 2021: to register, manage and archive vital records such as birth records, with a centralised CR database and a module for registration in local government offices
